title: Serving and assessment never rewrite a shared note's committed file
answers: why does .thinker/notes not change when notes are served
where does a shared note's local state go
body: Files under `.thinker/notes/` change only through an explicit `thinker share` (src/store.js:Store.promote), a sync pull, or a person editing them. Everything a checkout learns about a shared note (uses, servedIn, attest, status, staleness, a pending correction) goes to the overlay under `.thinker/local/shared/`: src/store.js:Store.put writes the overlay and leaves the committed file as it is whenever `isShared(id)`. So orienting, lookups, the end-of-session assessment (src/ops.js:attest) and background verification can run on every checkout without producing a dirty working tree or a merge conflict in the notes.
